rows.note: Two res.append Set-Cookie lines reach a raw socket client over real TinyHttpd 3.1.1 as a=1 then b=2.
header then append of a non-cookie name keeps both lines on the wire (TinyHttpd addHeader does not coalesce); header twice sends one line X-Probe: 2.
Servlet adapter on Jetty 9.4 keeps header then append as two X-Probe lines in order.

Scans every prose paragraph, list item and table row outside code fences in docs/api/*.md and docs/api/en/*.md that names defaultCache (app, static, defaults, response, ko and en); each states the res.relay exception.
Response#relay Javadoc says a relayed response never receives RestApp#defaultCache; RestApp#defaultCache Javadoc says a response sent with Response#relay never receives it.
